async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Fill the status textbox with 'Out of Office'
    status_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="What's your status?")
    if await status_textbox.count() > 0:
        await status_textbox.fill("Out of Office")
    else:
        raise Exception("Status textbox not found.")
    
    # Step 2: Save the changes by clicking the save button
    # Look for a save button; common labels in GitLab include 'Save changes' or 'Update profile'
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save changes").or_(page.get_by_role("button", name="Update profile"))
    if await save_button.count() > 0:
        await save_button.click()
    else:
        # If no save button found, check for other possible save elements
        submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit")
        if await submit_button.count() > 0:
            await submit_button.click()
        else:
            raise Exception("Save button not found.")
    
    # Step 3: Wait for the save operation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Brief pause to ensure changes are applied
    # No further actions needed; the function will return.
